title: CSCI 455 — Principles of Cybersecurity
subject: Cybersecurity
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define the core crosscutting concepts of confidentiality, integrity, and availability as foundational security properties.
Explain how the Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) practice groups structure secure software development processes.
Apply adversarial thinking and systems thinking to analyze real-world security risks and policy mechanisms.
